stemMd: When the original plan failed, the manager readily changed methods rather than defend it, showing a temperament that was ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Willingness to revise a failed approach supports adaptability. Adaptable and flexible preserve the same meaning; the opposite pair describes refusal to revise.

distractorRationale.f: Active adjustment is not lack of concern.
